what: On hover or when it becomes the current cell, five accent-color bands tilted (11 · −7 · 7 · −7 · 3°) drop in from above (-150%) over .6s (heights 13 · 18 · 32 · 25 · 27%), unfolding at .1s intervals to cover the cell, after .65s the background fills with the accent color and the text switches to the text color over accent (.3s). On release the bands fold in .1s and exit upward — game site vertical menu cell

options.--fx-fill: Strip and background color, default var(--kf-accent)
options.--fx-on: Text color after filling, default var(--kf-on-accent)
options.--fx-delay: Delay until the background fills, default .65s (about when the strip has fully covered it)

note: The current cell is aria-current(=not false) or marked with .is-active. Text inside a cell is wrapped as one block by the part and laid over the strip. Cell height is set by the user (strip height is a ratio of cell height)

from.where: shared.css .kj-headerPc__item a (.--line, five spans) — original right vertical menu cell: the current-section cell and hover react the same
